content.introduction: Big Tech earnings this week are expected to significantly influence market trends, with strong results likely to boost investor confidence and drive market growth. Analysts predict positive outcomes, potentially leading to new highs for global indices. The Magnificent 7's performance is crucial for the S&P 500.
body: Markets brace for Big Tech earnings as Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon(AMZN), Alphabet (GOOGL) and Meta Platforms (META) results test S&P 500 momentum, AI spending plans and forward guidance. Companies reporting and combining actual results with consensus estimates for companies yet to report, the S&P 500’s blended earnings growth rate for the quarter is 15.1% year over year, above the 13.2% expectations at the end of the quarter. Because technology companies are critical drivers of earnings growth and account for a significant percentage of the S&P 500’s market capitalization, the Magnificent 7 remains the group to watch this earnings season. Beyond earnings, the status of hostilities with Iran and oil prices are likely to remain a focus for financial markets this week. Interestingly, the financial markets continue to price in a low probability of an economic or earnings downturn despite the decline in the odds of the end of the conflict with Iran in the betting markets.
Big technology earnings this week could offer a much-needed catalyst for a market under pressure. How the companies perform is a major test.
